Net motion: gap -> QL interior.

Net motion: gap -> QL interior (shallow entry).

Same common in-gap start (z=15.517 A). Cr traverses fully through one QL's interior (images 2-3, z=12.6 and 8.9 A), re-enters the gap on the OPPOSITE side of that QL at image 4 (z=4.674 A, inside the detected 3.67-6.84 A gap band), and ends at image 5 (z=2.146 A) inside the next QL region. This is a more complex, two-QL-crossing trajectory than 1-2/1-3/1-4/1-7 (gap -> QL -> gap -> QL); classified gap2QL because it starts in a gap and ends inside a QL, but flagged medium confidence / worth human review because the 3-category scheme does not cleanly describe a double crossing.

Same common in-gap start (z=15.517 A). Substantial lateral (x,y) displacement within the gap plane (x: 2.11->4.21 A). Net motion: lateral diffusion within the gap, no QL crossing.

Same common in-gap start (z=15.517 A, centered in the 13.9-17.1 A gap). This matches the PI's explicit mapping: old pathway 1-7 = new gap2QL.

Same common in-gap start (z=15.517 A). Cr's z oscillates between 15.5 and 16.7 A across all 5 images, staying inside the gap band, with large lateral (x) motion (2.11->6.32 A) similar in character to 1-6. Classified gap-diff, but LOW confidence: the surrounding lattice layering is visibly disordered in this path's later images (many singleton z-layers instead of clean 4-atom Te/Sb sheets), consistent with this path's documented non-convergence/force-not-converged status, so the lattice itself may be poorly relaxed. Recommend human review before using this classification in the manuscript.
